messages.content: The user already ran query_reminders. Use the complete_reminder tool exactly once to mark the reminder whose id is "test-reminder-id-COMPLETE" as done. Then stop.

function.description: Mark a reminder as completed or un-complete it. Use query_reminders first to obtain the reminder_id.
function.name: complete_reminder

completed.description: true marks the reminder completed; false un-completes it.

reminder_id.description: calendarItemIdentifier of the reminder, from query_reminders.
